subject: Quick Update
body:
Hi Shubham,

 

Just a few hours ago, we released [a nice recap video](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfsTSz57aqxQDwjt4eorw9a/Ol_9SslvSvxM) from this year's EU-Startups Summit, and I thought I'd share it with you. :)

 

By the way: Have you already marked your calendar for next year's edition? In case you missed it, next year's [EU-Startups Summit](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfuMSVaQZQBsGJ3hF1Jeg66/KGmAMJj7V6Lh) will be held on May 7-8, again in beautiful Malta!

 

In the meantime, we're currently brainstorming about how to further optimise our editorial output, so we're curious to learn what your preferred channels are for consuming startup-related content? You can let us know [here](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfwFS25jXzQKIfNVPNoRQ2c/5tIASVgbXiez). 

 

And we're also curious which areas of tech innovation you are mainly interested in. Unfortunately LinkedIn polls only allow for 4 options, but please feel free to state your other areas of interest in the comments [here](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfy8RYb2WYemL1hJZkJE9z8/MD1-R-Sj93nX).

Selected teams will get expert support, $10K in AWS credits, and the chance to pilot their tech with Amazon. The hybrid programme runs from 8 Sept. to 3 October.

 

Have a great week!

 

Sunny greetings,

Thomas

subject: Startup Funding, Sunbathing & Sales Secrets
body:
Hi Shubham,


I hope you're enjoying the summer and you are reading this email with a cocktail in your hand, while sunbathing at the pool/beach. :) If not, and if you are still working as usual, I feel you. Most of the EU-Startups team and I are doing the same.


Either way: Here comes your weekly dose of European startup news, and some fresh insights and opportunities:

**🗳️ Your Opinion About AI:** Do you think AI will replace human-made music, movies, news media, etc. within the next 15 years? We asked our 126k Linkedin followers, and the poll is still open. [Cast your vote here](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ73AtvbXC92ZRaU3ySnsZC7e/R1xThUYmTgYT) and see what others think!


That's all I had to share with you this week Shubham. You can now dive right back into that pool, make sure to use sunscreen, and don't drink too many cocktails... :)

 

Cheers,

Thomas

Hi Shubham,

 

Not everything with the label AI actually has "real AI" in it, and quite a bit of the AI-generated content (images, videos, audio, text) that is currently flooding the web can be misleading or even harmful in some cases... 

 

In the end, what today's AI tools are spitting out in terms of content is mainly based on human IP that was scraped from across the web and from millions of publicly available data sources. John Oliver, from the Last Week Tonight show recently shared [a funny and insightful roundup regarding AI content](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfsTSz57aqxQDwjt4eorw9a/7NhghPBZg36Z), which I really enjoyed watching.

 

And here are some more updates and insights that might spark your interest. Not AI generated. Promised! :)

Hi Shubham,

 

Despite the summer heat, the European startup ecosystem is still buzzing with fresh deals, unexpected pivots, and ambitious founders making waves from Lisbon to Tallinn. Here are some of the biggest stories of this week:


💰 **Fresh VC Funds:** The [Greek Guarantee Fund](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfsTSz57aqxQDwjt4eorw9a/vS2TCNc63o8w) just closed with €600 million mobilised, creating real impact for SMEs, and Copenhagen-based[ BlackWood Ventures](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfuMSVaQZQBsGJ3hF1Jeg66/l0oiKnwjPAk0) closed its debut €22 million fund to back early-stage European Founders.


📊 **What do YOU think?** We just dropped two new polls on LinkedIn. 💊 **Health & BioTech Innovators: **


- London’s [LIfT BioSciences](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2ng01R56LV7tENO17k6o0tve/w7PpYff9obcp) just raised €12 million to tackle treatment resistance in solid tumours

🎯 **Ready to Fast-Track Compliance** for SOC 2, ISO 27001, or GDPR? Join Vanta’s on-demand product demo to see how 7,000+ companies automate security and save hundreds of hours on audit prep. [Learn how to get compliant in weeks](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2ng7ZPB7ZPOp2WpIMPYn9rhi/LZjbDlBoo-CB), not months, without slowing down your team.


🧠 **AI Funding Rounds of the Week:**


- London-based [Meet-Ting](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2ng9SOhcsNy3UZBcAZvHwbeE/989DMGBFA7Ej) just raised €289K to help you escape calendar chaos with its AI scheduling assistant.

- Stockholm-based [Tzafon](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7Aw4yIIFFx0lIHXJ5KV29nG/1ZjQGGI8M04O) raised a total of €8.3 million to scale AI compute and unlock the next wave of agentic AI. 
- Greek FoodTech innovator [StiQ](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7Ij90VYbLQgX2RKRsDcHrPO/_v9JT8bnkLJu) secured €20 million for its “Virtual Kitchen” platform.

While the US chased scale, EU startups are winning by focusing on specific sectors.

☀️ **Not your Regular Solar Panel: **Earlier this week we introduced you to** **10 European [startups harvesting the power of the sun](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ73AtvbXC92ZRaU3ySnsZC7e/fa272QC8GP1r) in unexpected and quite interesting ways! From floating photovoltaics and solar-powered trucks to graphene tech and stratospheric aircraft.

 

🛡️ **Cybersecurity & Defense:**


- London’s [DynaRisk](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7AxxxonYEWFDKdr7Fgzotjm/hxgYrq5FKPSm) raised €4 million to redefine cyber insurance. 
- Munich-based [Project Q](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7Il2023uJzuz4neG2a74bLu/45DIUGcoZJhI) secured €7.5 million to grow its IoD capabilities. 
- Milan-based [Trustfull](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7QY62FKGPTakoxROpTEKIy2/Kg3okRgdMURV) closed €6 million in fresh funding to help clients address emerging types of fraud. 
- Munich-based [ARX Robotics](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7YLA4SacUxGWZ7EXcMLa0aA/CKtPI5EuWzZY) raised €42 million to strengthen Europe’s tactical UGVs. 
 

🎧 **EU-Startups Podcast: **This week, [we sat down with Nikolaus Thomale](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7g8E6fqyaQwIJH1gPFSpiCI/VwHrFY1QHADt), Founder & Managing Director of MYNE Homes, a fast-growing company on track to build Europe’s leading co-ownership platform for vacation properties, to explore why traditional vacation home ownership is outdated and inefficient. Enjoy!

Cheers,

Thomas
